title: Medical Symptom Assistant
description: A conversational symptom checker powered by RAG. Users describe symptoms in plain language and receive AI responses grounded in MedlinePlus, WHO, and curated medical datasets.
detailDescription: Medical Symptom Assistant is an educational health information tool that combines hybrid retrieval-augmented generation with safety-first urgency classification. It helps users explore possible conditions and follow-up questions using authoritative public health sources — not as a substitute for professional medical care.

features.title: Conversational Symptom Q&A
features.description: Users describe symptoms in natural language and receive structured responses with possible conditions, follow-up questions, cited sources, and clear medical disclaimers.

features.title: Hybrid RAG Retrieval
features.description: Combines pgvector cosine similarity and PostgreSQL full-text search in parallel, then merges results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion for more relevant medical context.

features.title: Urgency Classification
features.description: A rule-based pre-retrieval classifier detects red-flag symptoms and vague queries so the assistant can prioritize urgent guidance or ask clarifying questions before generation.

features.title: Cross-Encoder Reranking
features.description: Locally runs a cross-encoder model to rescore and reorder retrieved passages, improving the quality of context sent to the LLM.

features.title: Authoritative Data Sources
features.description: Ingests and chunks content from MedlinePlus, WHO fact sheets, outbreak news, and Kaggle symptom-disease datasets into a searchable vector store.

features.title: Chat Sessions & Feedback
features.description: Persists multi-turn conversations with session history and collects user feedback to support iterative improvements to safety and response quality.
